properties.name: Moosalamoo Campground
properties.operator: Green Mountain & Finger Lakes National Forests
properties.fee_text: Camping fees: $15 per site per night. Fees payable at the self-service fee station.
properties.restrictions: Maximum stay limit is 14 days in a 30 day period. Dogs must be on a leash at all times. Quiet Hours are 10 PM – 6 AM. Check out time is 2 PM.

properties.name: Silver Lake Campground
properties.operator: Green Mountain & Finger Lakes National Forests
properties.fee_text: Camping fee: $10 per site per night Fees payable at self-pay station.
properties.restrictions: Maximum stay limit is 14 days in a 30 day period. Dogs must be on a leash at all times. There is no garbage service available, please carry out what you carry in.
